event_gold.title: Empty Cans!
event_gold.text: You find some empty cans on the floor.

event_spill.title: Spill!
event_spill.text: You slip on spilled beer. Take 2 damage and lose 2 cans.

event_klunk.title: Beer Tasting
event_klunk.text: You get hit with a penalty sip.

event_astronomisk_fylla.title: Cosmic Hangover
event_astronomisk_fylla.text: An otherworldly hangover — drink 2 penalty sips.

event_ljuset_i_tunneln.title: Light at the End of the Tunnel
event_ljuset_i_tunneln.text: You see the light at the end of the tunnel. Breathe out, recover 2 HP, and pick up 2 cans on your way out.

rest_brewery.title: Rest at the Brewery
rest_brewery.text: You catch your breath. +3 HP (up to max).

treasure_empty.title: Empty stash
treasure_empty.text: Someone got there first. Nothing left.

combat_monster.title: Combat
combat_monster.text: A bad batch appears. Roll to win.

boss_round_win.title: Round Won!
boss_round_win.text: The final boss still has life left. Confirm for the next round.

boss_final_win.title: Final Boss Defeated!
boss_final_win.text: You win the game. Confirm to see results.

choice_drink_or_damage.title: Bar Brawl
choice_drink_or_damage.text: Choose: take 1 sip or take 1 damage.

event_find_item_random.title: Found an Item!
event_find_item_random.text: You rummage in the corner and find something useful. Keep it for later.

event_quench.title: Quench Your Thirst
event_quench.text: You down a cold one. Take 1 sip and gain 2 HP.

event_sotsug.title: Sweet Tooth
event_sotsug.text: You get the munchies. Drink 2 sips and recover 4 HP.

event_friendly_offering.title: A Kind Gesture
event_friendly_offering.text: Choose a player: they take 1 sip and heal 2 HP.

event_loser_wins.title: Northern Melancholy
event_loser_wins.text: You take 2 sips. The player with the least HP gains 2 HP.

event_apocalypse.title: Brewapocalypse
event_apocalypse.text: The taps run wild. Everyone takes 1 sip.

event_gift_sip.title: A Gift from the Bar
event_gift_sip.text: Choose a player: they must take 1 sip.

event_round_on_me.title: Round's on Me!
event_round_on_me.text: You're feeling generous. Everyone heals 1 HP. You pay 1 can to each other player.

event_spilled_pints.title: Spilled Beer
event_spilled_pints.text: What a waste! Take 1 damage and +1 sip.

treasure_item_random.title: Treasure: Item
treasure_item_random.text: An item card lies in the stash.

item_sleep_potion.title: Sleeping Brew
item_sleep_potion.text: Use on another player: they skip their next turn.

item_sip_card.title: Beer Tasting
item_sip_card.text: Use on another player: they get +1 sip.

item_pretzel_snack.title: Pretzel
item_pretzel_snack.text: Use: restore 2 HP for yourself or another player.

item_beard_back.title: Beard in the Wind
item_beard_back.text: Pay 5 cans: double your combat roll.

item_yeast_sabotage.title: Shaken Beer
item_yeast_sabotage.text: Combat reaction: −1 attack. If the affected player loses combat, they skip a turn from beer in the eye.

item_beer_bro.title: Beer Bro
item_beer_bro.text: Combined attack: one extra player helps. On loss, both take damage; on win, the helper gets the same loot. Auto-loss only if both dice show 1.

event_faulty_brewery.title: Brewery Malfunction
event_faulty_brewery.text: The brewery breaks down. Pay 10 cans.

event_new_launch.title: New Beer Launch
event_new_launch.text: A new favorite sells out instantly. +6 cans.

event_baksmallebonus.title: Hangover Bonus
event_baksmallebonus.text: If you have 5 or more sips: gain 3 HP. Otherwise: 1 HP.

event_syndabock.title: Point the Finger
event_syndabock.text: Choose a player: they take 1 damage, you take 1 sip.

rollOutcomes.text: Give half your cans to the poorest player.
You fumble but keep your gear.

item_split_the_g.title: Split the G
item_split_the_g.text: Use on another player: take half their cans (rounded down).

item_not_my_round.title: Petty Theft
item_not_my_round.text: Use on another player: steal a random item or piece of equipment.

item_spill_intentional.title: Spill on Purpose
item_spill_intentional.text: Pay 2 cans and use on another player: destroy a random item or piece of equipment.

item_early_night.title: Sink It
item_early_night.text: Use in combat as attacker: skip the bad batch and end the encounter. No XP, no loot.

item_get_lucky.title: Get Lucky
item_get_lucky.text: Pay 5 cans: +4 attack. On loss, you take double damage.

item_manopositiv.title: Manopositiv
item_manopositiv.text: Combat reaction: pay 10 cans for +4 attack.

item_shortcut.title: Shortcut
item_shortcut.text: Use on your turn: pay 10 cans and teleport to any other player. Landing follows normal rules (encounter with players on the tile, tile effect).

item_taproom_key.title: Taproom Key
item_taproom_key.text: Use on your turn: go up one floor for the can cost — or on the top floor, go straight to the final boss tile.

item_six_sense.title: A Sixth Beer Sense
item_six_sense.text: Pay 5 cans and pick a number 1–6: your next roll (movement, bad batch combat, or BvB) shows that face. Card is consumed when you choose. Applies to both movement and bad batch encounters.

item_rigged_game.title: Rigged Game
item_rigged_game.text: Pay 5 cans and use on another player: take a random piece of equipment.

item_bribes.title: Bribes
item_bribes.text: Avoid combat for 10 cans. No XP, no loot.

item_paidassasin.title: Hired Gun
item_paidassasin.text: Pay 15 cans and use on another player: −5 attack in combat or the BvB round.

item_charity.title: Donate to Charity
item_charity.text: On your turn: each donated cans grants 1 HP (up to max).

item_shuffle.title: Shuffle
item_shuffle.text: Swap all your items with another player's items. Costs 10 cans.
